items.title: Breakfast: eat early
items.note: The buffet is crowded even in low season; go at opening. Take a few pieces of fruit as snacks for the day.

food.name: Panda Hotel breakfast buffet (熊猫酒店自助早餐)

items.title: Pack day bags
items.note: Water, snacks, power bank, jackets (December mornings and evenings are cool). Download the official Chimelong app for queue times and show schedules.
items.tip: Queue times and show schedules are shown in the Chimelong app; check once before entering.

items.title: Shuttle from hotel 2F to North Gate
items.note: Panda Hotel guests may enter 30 min before general visitors, via the North Gate only. Shuttles run ~every 10 min; do not take the one to the South Gate.

items.title: Morning: popular sights first
items.note: The guests-only early half hour is the most valuable; long-queue attractions are done first.

route.title: Safari train (小火车)
route.walk: Straight to the train station after entry
route.desc: General visitors are not in yet, so queues are shortest; later the wait reaches 1 hr. The ~35 min loop passes the big-cat area, giraffes and zebras, all seated.
route.tip: One source says the train only starts running at 09:30, so it may not be running during the guests-only first half hour. Check the first departure in the Chimelong app; if not running, go to the panda area first.

route.title: Panda Paradise (熊猫乐园)
route.desc: Pandas are most active in the morning, eating bamboo and climbing.

route.title: Koala Park (考拉园)
route.desc: Koalas sleep most of the day; movement is more likely in the morning.

items.title: Lunch: Panda Restaurant
items.note: Enter at 11:45 and order before the 12:00 rush.

food.name: Panda Restaurant (熊猫餐厅)
food.desc: In-park themed restaurant with panda-shaped dishes

food.name: Park fast-food outlets (园区快餐店)
food.desc: Nearest one on the route; fastest

items.title: Rest break
items.note: Sit through an indoor show or the 4D cinema to rest for an hour. Schedules per the app.

items.title: Afternoon: animal feeding and cable car

route.title: Asian Elephant Park (亚洲象园)
route.desc: Bananas can be bought to feed the elephants; price as posted on site.

route.title: Giraffe Plaza (长颈鹿广场)
route.desc: Giraffe feeding is the most popular activity and queues are long; one person can queue while the others rest nearby.
route.tip: Feed is sold separately; price as posted on site.

route.title: Dessert stop
route.desc: In-park ice cream or café kiosks: cakes, hot drinks.

route.title: Cable car (空中缆车)
route.walk: Follow the signs to the cable car station
route.desc: The loop takes ~30 min; the whole park is seen from above while seated.

route.title: Flamingo Lake and gift shop (火烈鸟湖、纪念品店)
route.desc: Final flamingo photos, souvenirs, then exit.

items.title: Back to the hotel, rest
items.note: Shower; the drone show is tonight.

items.title: Dinner
items.note: The buffet is crowded; go at opening. To skip queues, order à la carte at the Food Town.

food.name: Panda Hotel restaurant (熊猫酒店餐厅)
food.desc: Least effort after a full day

food.name: Food Town (美食小镇)
food.desc: À la carte; shorter queues than the buffet

food.name: White Tiger Buffet (白虎自助餐厅)

items.title: Drone show (TBC)
items.note: Time and location as announced by reception or the Chimelong app. If the show is on the 26th, move this slot to that evening.

intro:
Chimelong Safari Park — early entry for hotel guests
Morning: safari train, pandas, koalas, white tigers
Afternoon: elephant and giraffe feeding, cable car
Evening: drone show (TBC)
